LanguageData.INSDoor_Fibre.label: Insulated Autodoor (Fibre)
LanguageData.INSDoor_Fibre.description: A fibre-insulated door that divides rooms and has an insulation-value of 60%. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
LanguageData.INSDoorSimple_Fibre.label: Insulated Door (Fibre)
LanguageData.INSDoorSimple_Fibre.description: A fibre-insulated door that divides rooms and has an insulation-value of 60%. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
